local companies = tool('list_companies', {})
local domain_to_company = {}
for _, c in ipairs(companies) do
  if c.domain then
    domain_to_company[c.domain:lower()] = c.name
  end
end

local function normalize_phone(phone)
  if not phone or phone == '' then return nil, false end
  -- Already valid E.164 US: +1 followed by exactly 10 digits
  if phone:match('^%+1%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$') then
    return phone, false
  end
  -- Extract digits only
  local digits = phone:gsub('%D', '')
  if #digits == 10 then
    return '+1' .. digits, true
  elseif #digits == 11 and digits:sub(1,1) == '1' then
    return '+' .. digits, true
  elseif #digits > 0 then
    -- try best effort: if starts with 1 and has 11+, or just prepend +1 for 10
    if #digits == 11 and digits:sub(1,1) == '1' then
      return '+' .. digits, true
    end
    -- fallback: take last 10 digits
    if #digits >= 10 then
      local last10 = digits:sub(-10)
      return '+1' .. last10, true
    end
  end
  return phone, false
end

local phones_fixed = 0
local companies_filled = 0
local page = 1
local total_pages = 1

repeat
  local r = tool('list_contacts', { page = page })
  total_pages = r.total_pages
  for _, contact in ipairs(r.items) do
    local updates = { id = contact.id }
    local need_update = false

    local new_phone, phone_changed = normalize_phone(contact.phone)
    if phone_changed and new_phone then
      updates.phone = new_phone
      need_update = true
      phones_fixed = phones_fixed + 1
    end

    local company_empty = not contact.company or contact.company == ''
    if company_empty and contact.email then
      local domain = contact.email:match('@(.+)$')
      if domain then
        domain = domain:lower()
        local cname = domain_to_company[domain]
        if cname then
          updates.company = cname
          need_update = true
          companies_filled = companies_filled + 1
        end
      end
    end

    if need_update then
      tool('update_contact', updates)
    end
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > total_pages

return { phones_fixed = phones_fixed, companies_filled = companies_filled }
